_note: Versions the importer knows (docs/plan/10-importer.md section 3, Appendix A/B). A supported profile matches when every key file of each disk is found by name (case-insensitive, matched on the path's tail; '*' = any name) and sha1. Same names, other hashes = 'unknown build' (not imported: the extractors read fixed offsets). mutable_files: files play rewrites, with their pristine sha1 (a mismatch = a played copy). images: whole-image fingerprints (reference dumps, and versions recognised by hash only). status: supported (has a pipeline), planned (pipeline being written), recognised (named, not imported).

profiles.title: Phantasie I (Apple II)
profiles._note: The 4am crack's .dsk pair and the original .woz pair (the same played copy; no unplayed Apple II I is known). mutable_files: TWN1..TWN11 / TWN99 at the sha1s of side B's TF slices (BACKUP's new game stores TF's 250-byte slices as the town files, so a fresh game has them); the import reads TF, not these. CHAR and OUTn have no pristine copy; the import takes only CHAR's elementals (kept by a new game) and gives the regions DOS I's start state (reverse-engineering/apple2/phantasie1/FORMAT.md).
